notes.title: Our fifth Major Update: Tourist Trap, is here!
notes.content:
The Tourist Trap Update is here, and with it comes a bustling mix of new visitors, specific requests, unique landmarks, and some good ol’ industrial-grade expansion.

There’s absolutely loads to unpack and major changes to how tourism works as well as lots more complex buildings to do, and we’re SO excited for you to dig in. 

Here’s what’s new:


🗺️ Tourists With Opinions (And Desires!)
Tourists now have personalities, preferences, and demands. Each type brings their own set of desires - Entertainment, Rest, Hunger, Health, Exploration, and Shopping -  and how well you meet those needs affects your town rating.

Build with a balance in mind… or don’t. But don’t be surprised when they complain to the boss (that’s you)! 
⭐️ Food & Shopping Ratings
Every recipe now has a star rating! Some tourists have expensive taste, others are happy with a hot dog on a stick. Offer a mix of 1, 2, and 3-star items to satisfy everyone, or risk scaring off your posh punters and your bargain-hunters. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/89ca197442bbfed1e58c27f68863ea575d9301ec.jpg"]
💬 Tourist Thought Bubbles
You’ll now see exactly what tourists think with new emoji-style thought bubbles - happy, frustrated, or looking for something that doesn’t exist yet, because you forgot to build it. It’s all tracked in your Tourist Tracker hub, which you can turn off if the crushing weight of public judgement becomes too much. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/a04199261896aabdb03c8076603467f4a1642f5c.png"]
🧢 Hot New Bombshells Enter the [strike]Villa[/strike] Town 
Our new tourist type, Easy-Goers, are chill and easy to please - so they're going to be with you from the moment you start building a new town, to give you a bit of breathing room while you’re working things out. You’ll know them by their snazzy straw hats.

Plus: We’ve officially added Robots, Dinosaurs, Aliens, Clowns into the tourist pool to join the Ghosts, Mummies, and Werewolves! They’ll all arrive via a new method though…


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/b0e60d33b779e574df79515262affbebb63c946a.jpg"]
🏟️ Transit Terminals
Want more aliens? Build the Moon Terminal. More clowns? Build the... well, Clown Tent. These new Tourist Spawners let you control who visits your town. And yes — you can build them and leave them OFF if you want to ban clowns forever.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/cfdb7b4a84dfca81937081595e209b254861387b.png"]


⛰️ CLIFF. TERRAFORMING. IS. HERE. FINALLY!!!!!
Need space for your mega-stadium? Tear down that cliff. You can now build and destroy cliff tiles across the main map after you unlock \[REDACTED]. Go nuts.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/82fa6b7771d9a97a4daa88a2144ac8caef318db5.jpg"]
🧑‍🏭 New Townies
With new tourists come new townies! One for each exotic tourist type. Recruit them to unlock their transit terminal and attract more of their kind.


🏗️ Major Landmarks + Tier 3 Industry
Want to supercharge your tourism game? Build one of four Massive Landmarks:

Stadium (Entertainment)

Hot Springs (Health)

Conservatory (Rest)

Lighthouse (Exploration)

But you’ll need serious infrastructure — including the new Factory and Tier 3 materials like Reinforced Brackets, Encabulator Cubes, and more. It’s time to upgrade your industry!

 
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/54e3f88c5391b048839d00f3571403e6a28666ff.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/a1cc815e526f9be86627b910ad517728037816ef.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/837e7ed700c2eb796ccbd8c533b92937eaabb9da.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/51edcf5af915853f3360adf58172710708364d75.jpg"][/carousel]🛢️ YUM GREASE™️+  New Recipes
Yes. YUM GREASE™️ is real. Use it in your factory for that extra slide. Plus, cook up:

 Lava Lamps

 Dirty Mags

Seafood Sticks

A balanced diet, right?


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/ab6f029f3a585c89e50bc50279064325c20b5a8f.jpg"]
🔧 + QoL Improvements & Preview Branch
There’s a bunch of small improvements and fixes too — from UI tweaks to performance boosts. And for those who like living on the edge, remember you can opt in to the Preview Branch to test upcoming features before they go live (don’t worry — your save is safe).


 …and just one more thing (ok, three)
We’ve got a few things that we’ve saved for launch—not even the Preview Branch has seen these yet! 


WATERFALLS
While you’re tearing down your cliffs, don’t forget to save a few to add waterfalls to. Add water close to the edge of the cliff, and it will make a waterfall. This means you can add water tiles to the cliff level too, so feel free to build out a series of very high lakes to admire.


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd665PqSI2u5SbPzssQx9hSQPRTUORopUr25lkvFyISIT53Ax_jpllASAGF1YIKoyiWKm-H_OqjZyT528Q31IQt6EPaM-bJqk4N8K6hJrvMiiKd8S6gYGWKKgtc_43_jRFhgGx8?key=lxM26WILRYKIvdrfVHhUC-oS"]
WATER JETS
Got a body of water (either natural or man-made) that you want to spruce up? Add a fountain jet! You can rotate between three variants (up high, low arc and high arc) to create the fountains of your dreams.


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfPwKD4HeqTq-Xct8WykvpmroUxvSnQplwy4VE4lzji4SqS4fJ5xUH6WE5ouhZItIO7Lbr320FRR4Hu_CjNcuYFbaQGN8KmNj-r0X0I6laehIHcIAdcoVjv-o8QivOJISubPosZ8g?key=lxM26WILRYKIvdrfVHhUC-oS"]
NEW TERRAIN TILES
With our new urbanism, we’ve added four new terrain tiles to collect and augment in your town. They’ll rotate in to Tiny Timba’s shop to purchase! (and we’ve also adjusted the borders on other tiles so they match a bit better!)


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdPWhAxtL0UkkYjOJNLkGgvUoYNAerfSG7x5Ea4vM4AWcy4KweCXQuIr64E458Mm2ZvF_DJGzHt5cb1QQUikB8tyLJRlAeg9qw44XlKTaAbIJ6hSj31WVmL6TARhL-_y13JSewTlA?key=lxM26WILRYKIvdrfVHhUC-oS"]


[hr][/hr]

💬 Tell us what you think!
We’re always listening, like a true omnipotent force. 

So whether your town is a five-star utopia or a flaming bin alley with a Lighthouse, we want to see it! You can find us here: 

Join the Discord

Bluesky

Twitter

TikTok

Thank you SO much for helping us shape Go-Go Town! We’re just getting started, so stay tuned for more exciting updates coming soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Build 0.6.98.20437
notes.content:
Major5 - Tourist Trap
0.6.98.20437
Tourist Updates
 Behaviour, preferences, and desires... tourist AI has had an overhaul! Tourist types now have distinct preferences, desires and traits. Fulfilling these affects their EGO review of your town. Build menu objects are marked as showing how effective they are at meeting desires. These are: Entertainment Rest Hunger Health Exploration Shopping Food and shopping items now have a 3-star preference system. You'll need to offer a wide variety of items to keep your tourists happy! Reduced tourist train frequency from 6 trains to 4 trains a day Removed "exotic" tourist types from arriving on the train (Exotic townies will still appear on the train) Updated the spawn balance of the regular tourist types to have a better mix of each tourist type
New Tourist Type
 Easy-goers: A simple tourist type that as long as their most basic needs are met, they're hard to displease!
Tourist Thought Bubbles
 Tourists will periodically share their thoughts on what they're experiencing, giving you an insight into their behaviour and needs. New options in the Gameplay tab, allowing you to choose how vocal they are.
Townpedia Updates
 Added new guide entries for each tourist type which describes what desires they require as well as what traits they have Added guide entry for explaining tourist desires
Tier 3 Industry
 Build the Factory to fuse togethor resources from multiple industries  Produce space-age wonder materials! perfect for advanced large scale projects (as well as more specialized use-cases...) Expandable Rod Encabulator Cube Reinforced Brackets Structural Plating
New Fishing Industry Resource
 Craft Yum Grease from Deep Sea Cutlets Added recipes to select fitouts to use Yum Grease Lava Lamp added to the Crafter medium fitout Seafood Sticks added to the Fish N Chip Shop small fitout Dirty Mag added to the Book Nook small fitout Yum Grease is also used in the manufacturing of Tier 3 materials!
New Townies
 7 new exotic townies to invite to live and work in your town! Each townie will offer a new Transit Terminal to build... [spoiler]...Some of their townie friends will need to be in your town[/spoiler] before they appear though! 2 new "regular" townies. Yep, totally normal.
Transit Terminals
 You'll now be able to build Transit Terminals to allow your more... exotic tourist types to visit. 7 new Transit Terminals to build Ability to open/close each terminal, allowing you to customize your tourist flow. Please note this changes the spawn behaviour of existing 'exotic' tourists.
Major Landmarks
 Invest your hard earned resources into constructing new Major Landmarks: Lighthouse Conservatory Hot Springs Stadium These iconic buildings aren’t just for show; they'll help tourists fulfill their desires.
Terraforming Updates
 At a certain point, you'll unlock the ability to edit and place elevated tile types. This gives you access to: Cliff Clear out extra land or add Cliffs where you'd like them! New Cliff Water terraforming tile Make elevated bodies of water Produces waterfalls when on the edge of cliffs Forest Edge Dense forest foliage We've refined the Sand, Slow-Sand, and Dirt tile visuals for a more natural, organic appearance. Footpath tile updates and additions Footpath tile types now have colored edging to improve the previous 'gray outline' visual We've made 4 new tile types to decorate your town with, check with trader Tina Timba Olde Towne Pavers Peach Piazza Scalloped Flagstone Arcade Blocks
Customization Options
 Houses/Apartments are no longer random; choose which variation you want with the 'Cycle Visual' feature in build mode Added new visual variants for certain directional barriers and lampposts Lamp Post Gothic Lamp Post Metro Lamp post Park Light Firefly Lamp Post Hanging Lanterns Lantern Lamp post Bamboo Barrier Green Bamboo Barrier Wood Fence Highway Barrier Roadworks Barrier Rose Bush Barrier Flaming Barrel Water Jet; a new water based decoration that can be angled and rotated for water displays "Pink Flamingo" has been renamed to "Plastic Flamingo", and now supports custom painting 
Courier Delivery Priority
 Manage the courier delivery priority on fitouts, food carts, market stalls and the new factories. You can now set the courier delivery priority to High, Standard, Low or None
UI Improvements
 Added new User Icons for tourist types (Aliens, Clown, Dino, Ghost, Mummy, Robot, Wolf) Added a tally to show the number of fitouts built in town when inspecting in the manage menu Added support for showing item tags on recipe cards Show desire panels when hovering and moving props
Audio updates
 Trains now CHOO-CHOO and have arrival/departure whistles New voice types for Aliens, Dino's (Grarr), and another neutral tourist variant type
Misc. Changes
 Moved the fireworks launchers to the basic category and the wishing well out of the statues group in the build menu Added map filter for new tourist spawners Small adjustments to early game pacing to make it easier to generate EGO and unlock early EGO packages Increased the input storage size of the Book Nook small fitout so that it can fit new recipes and has more room for ingredients Added Tripod Work Light to Trader Griswald's inventory. Rich tourists drop coins 50% of the time When leaving town, tourists now react with their EGO review BEFORE visually exiting Updated Hypnotron visual
Bugfixes
 Fixed an issue where workers would ignore newly placed transition levels (ie mines) until they quit and reloaded the game Fix crashes when clown spawners were set to disabled Fixed issue where prop colliders could persist after build mode, causing tourists to get stuck Resolved issue where tourists would complain about rest if they had filled their idle stat Reduced the distance that clown shoes are heard at Squared up the garbage bin offsets for rotation alignment Fixed issue where you could terraform cliff and water tiles under POI objects Coins dropped by rich tourists will now vanish after an hour Rich tourist wallets will no longer get bigger each time they drop a coin Various performance improvements Fixed some rules allowing undesired terraforming beneath players/actors Prevent overlapping tourist speech bubbles Fixed a bug in which a passenger could store a vehicle sending the vehicle (and the driver) to Limbo.

notes.title: What's in our next Major Update, Tourist Trap?
notes.content:
Hello Mayors! 


With the Steam Summer Sale kicking off (and Go-Go Town! at our deepest discount yet!: 25% off!) we wanted to talk a bit about our upcoming Major Update, Tourist Trap. It’s coming out July 15th / 16th (depending on where you are in the world!) 


But first! We’re so excited that we’ve got a great bundle with our friends at OddSparks and Little Big Workshop! You can nab all three games in a bundle, or fill out your building & automation portfolio if you’ve already got a copy of Go-Go Town!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46995/Relax_With_Cozy_Builders/"][/dynamiclink]

We've got two main pillars of Tourist Trap, a huge overhaul to how tourists operate, and new industry features (more things to build, more complicated recipes), so let's dive in! 


Tourism
Tourist Updates 🎟️🏋🏼🛀🏾🔭 Tourists have always been opinionated, but now they're even moreso! Each type of tourists has their own preferences, desires, and traits, which influences how they rate your town. There are six desires: Entertainment, Rest, Hunger, Health, Exploration, and Shopping, and items will show you which category they are. Make sure to include a range of interests as you build up your town!

Food & Shopping Star Ratings ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Recipes for food and shopping now have star ratings, and your tourists will seek out things to eat and buy at different levels. Got too many 1 star food options? Your posh tourists will turn down their noses. But if you only have 3 star options, you'll annoy tourists with 1 and 2 star tastes—adjust accordingly! 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/89ca197442bbfed1e58c27f68863ea575d9301ec.jpg"]

Tourist Thought Bubbles 💬 You'll see little dialogue options pop up when they're pleased, angry, or looking for something your town doesn't have. This is all tracked in the Tourist Tracker, and don't worry—you can turn it off if it's too much!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/e6803fd775d1e02eb23665f39b09b6a434aa1d67.jpg"]

New Tourist Types 🧑🏽‍🌾 Worried about how all the picky tourists will influence your early gameplay? Don't worry! We've added a new type, Easy-Goers, that are pretty easy to please, and they'll show up when you build a new town. You'll be able to recognize them from their snazzy straw hats! PLUS we'll now officially have tourists like Dinosaurs, Robots, and Clowns to the tourist pool—but they've got a special way to arrive...

Transit Terminals 🌋🌕🎪 Want those exotic tourist types in your town? (That is: Mummies, Werewolves, Aliens, Robots, Dinosaurs, Ghosts and Clowns) Each of these will now come to your town from a specific spawner. Build it, and you'll have your town flooding with that tourist. Don't ever want Clowns? You can always build their spawner and just never turn it on!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/cc245bbb4d01a63c7cfba842ba6f75d3b0f33ab7.jpg"]

New Townies 🐺👽🦖 And of course, we always need new Townies to put to work be valued members of our community. There will be 7 new townies, one each for the exotic tourist types, and they'll help you invite more of their kind into your town with that recipe for their specific Transit Terminal.


Industry
Major Landmarks 🏟️♨️ We've added four new BIG buildings you can build to support tourism in your town. Build the Lighthouse, Conservatory, Hot Springs, and Stadium to boost your tourists' desire for exploration, rest, health, and entertainment. These take up a lot of room and even more complicated materials, so start carving out space!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/534456b37bab3145df64af506ef0235bcb93107d.jpg"]

Tier 3 Industry 🏭 If you want to build those Major Landmarks, you're going to have to build a Factory first. This will help you create new Tier 3 items: the expandable Rod, Encabulator Cube, Reinforced Brackets, and Structural Plating, all of which will be used in large-scale building. To make them, you'll need a lot of Tier 2 materials, so it'll put your supply chain to the test!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/0daed775ef7390a66fab04547d0779f2617e1388.jpg"]

Yum Grease! 🛢️ Want to get things moving in your factory? Maybe a way to... grease the wheels? Put your Deep Sea Cutlets in the Fish thing, and you'll make YUM GREASE™️. We've also added three new recipes to shops, so you'll be able to make Lava Lamps, Dirty Mags, and Seafood Sticks. Yum!


And one more thing...
Cliff Terraforming is here! ⛰️ Need more room for those major landmarks? TEAR DOWN THE CLIFFS! Once you've \[ REDACTED ], you'll be able to build and destroy cliffs to your heart's content across the main map!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/aecd1566e0fb8918f6f21c2666d9821c4101ecbd.jpg"]

There's also a ton of QOL updates, and even some sneaky things we haven't even released to our Preview Branch yet! If you want to check it out now, you can opt in to our Preview Branch via the instructions below, which is where we test things out before they go live. Your save file will be safe, don’t worry! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195120/view/4355629296424398812?l=english"][/dynamiclink]Stay tuned on our social media for more deep dives about things in Tourist Trap, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of it!

Cheers,

Emily and the Go-Go Town! team

notes.title: 2025 Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Mayors! 

This year, as always is moving quickly, and we wanted to pop in to give you an overview of our plans for the upcoming year! We’ve been deep in the throes of online co-op, and finding new things to optimize every day. But we’ve also been cooking up some new things for you before co-op! 

Tourists: you love them, you wish they would stop littering everywhere—what if you could read their minds? What if they also had specific wants for food, shopping, and entertainment? Great news! We’ll be doing a complete overhaul of how tourists work for our next Major Update called (appropriately) Tourist Trap, which will add new strategy for both early and late-game players. Stay tuned, as this is almost ready to go into Preview Build, and if you’re wiling to dive in, we’d love to have feedback about it! 

And here’s our beautiful looking roadmap for 2025, with a look at what we’ve done early in the year as well as what’s coming up: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/4dddd7a5c2470e57f5a24a2cb1203ca86b716ed0.jpg

Also, this week is the beginning of the Cozy & Family-Friendly Games Celebration on Steam, and Go-Go Town! is 20% off as a result. There are also some great games and demos available, so we wanted to showcase a few demos and games we’ve been enjoying

TAVERN KEEPER (DEMO)
Our friends at Greenheart Games have released their demo of a tavern management sim, and it’s just a delight (and of course we’re fans of management games!). Hire workers, figure out layouts, temperature, filth level, unlock new drinks and meals and be the best Tavern Keeper you can be. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2833530/Tavern_Keeper__Demo/
TINY BOOKSHOP (DEMO)
We’ve been excited for this one for a while—and they just announced a release date for this August! Manage your own mobile bookshop, travel around, meet customers, stock books they need. A beautiful game, and the devs are very nice (we were both at the Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133760/Tiny_Bookshop/ 
IS THIS SEAT TAKEN (DEMO)
From Wholesome Games’s publishing arm, this is a cute puzzler where you have to figure out how to place people in a scene where they’re all satisfied. Trickier than it looks, but really satisfying controls and cute to boot. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035120/Is_This_Seat_Taken/
ISLANDS AND TRAINS (OUT NOW!) 
A beautiful diorama creator focused on—you guessed it—islands and trains. It’s very meditative and calming, a great little way to give your brain a break if you’ve been deep in other games (ask us how we know)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1957760/Islands__Trains/

Now go get playing! 

Cheers,

Emily and the Go-Go Town! team

notes.title: Our fourth Major Update, Spring Cleaning, is here! 🧹
notes.content:
Hello Mayors! 

We’re so excited that our fourth Major Update: Spring Cleaning, is now available! We hunkered down and focused on quality of life improvements, and they include some pretty major ones that we know you all have been looking for! ✨ And with the Spring Sale kicking off, the game is now 20% off! ✨

You can check out the full patch notes here, but we’ve listed out some key ones below as well: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/379a14e000a5254259141b6b4d875998992de0cc.gif
Personal Vehicle & Tools 🪚🚙 You can now store a tool and a vehicle in a patented TownCo Dimensional Pockets, allowing quick an easy access at a moments notice! Includes a new UI Widget to help track your currently stored items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/deae0a19954d1b2e016e0f1af51eb58a9c3771ff.jpg
Town Info App ℹ️ Everything you want to know about your town - now in the palm of your hand! What fitouts you have, where your workers are, what shops need what food, housing, and more. It'll alert you when there's a problem (Mana Extractor is full, NPC is stuck trying to get where they want to go) too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/e284053de1569d11a67bb120679bf6351eb1e728.gif
360° Camera Rotation 🔁🎥 You've asked for it, we've... put it as an experimental setting for you to rotate the camera 360°! Head to options and you'll be able to turn this on, and you can rotate to your heart's content. You can also increase the orbit a bit more horizontally for non-experimental play!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/615438ee73ebdaf390cc67eed5d63dd38f991b47.jpg
Rotate NPC housing 🔁🏘️ Build the apartment and housing blocks of your dreams. You can now rotate small houses and apartments in any direction you'd like! They also now have a visual indication if there's an empty spot to add a townie in

Animal Feed Refinement 🐄 Tired of those feed drops cluttering up your farm? No longer! We've added a new machine, the Automated Feed Maker, which generates feed over time, so you can have a farm for your animals with none of those pesky crops.

Trader Improvements 🛍️ We've got a few updates for the Traders, but first up: a new UI! You can purchase as many items as you want from available stock, can buy from their back catalog AND can see that there are items you have yet to collect!

Managed Stalls 🛒 You can now set up to 5 items on Market Stalls and Vending Machines for couriers to auto-deliver!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/66e4f4facefa941b9411a8ed20b0ef384405a713.jpg
Music Updates 🎶 We've added new music AND now have multiple playlists you can choose from based on your vibe. Will you choose "Mega Mingle" "Lo-fi and Chill" or "Funk n Bop"? And if you're not vibing with a song, remove it entirely, or if you really like it, create a playlist of your favorites.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/49f82295ed8898b79042b1d330844cabb6e6a197.jpg
Light in Dark Spaces 💡 Fear caves and sewers no more - you'll have a light around you in dark environments to help show the way.

Text And Drive 🤳🏼 Wait no! Well, you can now access your phone while riding a vehicle or using a tool. Please use SlothOS responsibly

New food cart 🌮 Hungry? The new Tac-Oh! truck with its taco recipe is sure to give your tourists what they need.

Crab & Lobster Pots 🦀🦞 There's a new pot, the Lobster Pot, which only harvests lobsters. This means the normal Crab Pot will now only catch crabs (and has a snazzy new look). They'll take a bit more time now to harvest - but worth the wait!

…and much, much more:

Scooter 🛵 You saw it in the demo, it got removed and we didn't realize it (whoops!), but it's BACK - a scooter of your very own to import.

Infinite Seeds 🌱 Now your farmers are pulling their weight! Seeds are now infinite, and can be planted as many times as you want. Crops will now automatically reset after harvest too!

Weather Randomization 🌸☔️ Ironically, this means weather will now follow a more predictable pattern. Cherry Blossoms for all!

Fourth Worker Slot for Industries 👥👥 Put even MORE townies to work with a fourth slot now available for the Mining, Forestry and Fishing Zones

Customization & Color Palette Improvements 🎨 Even more things to be painted: bridges, garbage bins, and things in the park (swings, slide, lights, bench). We've also made the color palette tool even better, and you can cycle through colors in a swatch!

Key rebinding ⌨️ <100% keyboards, rejoice! There are even more bindable keys for player movement & camera controls

Alternative Milk 🫛 There are now non-dairy cheese and butter recipes for the Dairy Maker. Start planting your soy beans! We've also updated Challenge 04 to ask you to build a dairy maker instead of a cow stall, in case you don't want to build an animal farm at all.

New Exterior Visuals 🆕 A fresh coat of paint and adjustments on things. Rustic Picnic Table and Outdoor Settings are now dockable, car parks and bike racks have variants. You can now build in the Alien spawning zone. Four new channels to set the TV to. And more!

…and of course, we couldn’t help ourselves and added a few new decor items too! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/70ebfd55d8ad72166813600160e61acc6915bb1e.jpg

Cheers,

Emily and the Prideful Sloth team

notes.title: A sneak peek at our next Major Update, Spring Cleaning!
notes.content:
Hello Mayors! 

We’ve been hard at work since we came back from the holiday season at building out our fourth Major Update, which we're calling Spring Cleaning! 

It's coming in a couple weeks, on March 13th, but if you want to get a sneak peek of it in action, we've pushed it to our Preview Build so you can hop in today! (Here's instructions of how to opt-in to the Preview Build)

What's it going to entail, you may ask? Quite a bit! We've focused on a ton of quality of life updates, many of which have been suggested by the community. From new ways of interacting with feed to weather patterns, updates to traders, new visuals, the list is very long and has some very highly requested features! 360° camera rotation (!!)

Emily and the Go-Go Town! team

notes.title: Go-Go Town! End of Year Recap
notes.content:
How is it already the end of 2024?! Time has flown by this year. It also seems like we released a lifetime ago, but only a short while ago. Time can be odd like that!

The team worked really hard on our last update! We are darn proud of what we’ve achieved and feel that we are in a good place to take a few weeks’ break to recharge a bit.

But first, a look back: 

Go-Go Town! started as a concept back in early 2022. And after only 11 months in development, we were already announcing the game to the world in March 2023 at the Future Games Show Spring Showcase and PAX East. We were thrilled to be part of PAX Rising that year, especially as we felt the game was too early to be talking about - but we did it anyway! The initial feedback was great, and by June 2023 we worked with the great folks at Wholesome Games to announce our first play test at Wholesome Direct.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/4c54b3669b8f9bcbf7ecdde7c7e4d3758ae453cc.gif

Fast forward to 2024 (and four playtests later), the feedback was incredible and we felt that Go-Go Town! was in a great place to share with the world — but we also saw incredible potential for the game to grow even further. That’s why we chose to release in Early Access in June, so we could work more closely with the community to shape its future together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/6b49c6be2aebae41745cbefd9c77e42469432af9.jpg
We have LOVED the decision to go to Early Access! This is our studio's first Early Access game, and our first 'open' development game. And gosh, Go-Go Town! has certainly had a bit of a glow up over the past 6 months thanks to our community :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/8482c32a979fcc59759eb78e5085f2ef44f50604.png
While we are super happy with the progress we’ve made in 2024, there's still so much more we have planned. 2025 is going to be a cracker of a year!

Some of our major goals for 2025 are:

 Getting online co-op into your hands | After player housing, this is the #1 thing you all want, and we want to make sure it’s great. This means giving the local co-op a polish pass, too :)
 More Sim/Automation/Town Building gameplay | We’ve added a lot on the creative expression end of things, so next year we want to focus on expanding the sim/management/automation side.
 MORE CONTENT INCOMING! | We've heard your requests for new items/objects to discover (and interact with), so we’ve got plans for even more, both indoors and outdoors, to expand and decorate your town.
 New features and polish | We’re dedicated to making this game truly one-of-a-kind, with features and mechanics you won’t find elsewhere. 2025 will bring more innovations along with a focus on refining the overall experience to make it shine.

Not only did we produce THREE Major Updates in 2024 (one of which was a crossover with Dinkum!), we’ve also worked on stability and bug fixes and released SIX Minor Updates as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/15c4cacd1f576db8d59f7bad5ae98d928469d1cd.png
And finally, we received three awards this year, as well as multiple GOTY accolades from outlets, which we feel incredibly honored by.

 Best In Show - Screen Queensland Awards
 Best Social Game - TIGA Games Industry Awards
 Coziest Co-op - Cozy Quest Awards

We’re excited about getting a break (who wouldn’t be!), but we also can’t wait to return in January – refreshed and ready to dive back into Go-Go Town! with fresh eyes (and brains) to map out what 2025 will look like for us.

As we bid farewell to 2024, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has supported us, believed in our vision, and recognized the value of what we’re creating.

Here’s to 2025 and the next evolution (but totally not its final form) of Go-Go Town!

❤️ the Prideful Sloth team

p.s. and here's a little visual wrap up & look ahead!

notes.title: Go-Go Town! Developer Update, 27th September
notes.content:
Hi all!

Thank you to everyone who has joined us for the Build + Bustle update.

We’ve had fantastic feedback from the community, and we have some updates and bug fixes on the way!

We aim to have our next update into our Preview Branch early next week, and I’ll give you an ETA by the end of next week as to when it will be dropping into Main Game.

Some of the changes you can expect in the update include:

 Moved Water terrain tile from tier 5 to tier 2 EGO Tech.
 Fix issues with workers stuck in loops attempting to achieve tasks (what some of you would have reported as 'jugging')
 Workers will no longer collect excess maker output (or dropping them on the ground)
 This means they will stop dropping these items on the ground
 Workers were putting items in makers when the output item wasn't desired
 Workers were not checking if they could store maker ingredients
 Updates to the eyes and mouth drawing in front of glasses
 Updates for performance issues (we heard you Steam Deck players)

We also have some plans in place for our next Minor update, which leads us on to….

Predictability vs Random Chance

Based off feedback, and bug reports, we are going to start reworking some of the systems in Go-Go Town!

Some of our systems are based on random chance (weather patterns, what crab pots bring up, foraging, etc) and this random chance can also include number of items received per an attempt. These systems mean that players cannot predict what they, or an NPC, can produce from an action.

So! Over the next few updates, we are going to start working through the systems that have random chance and  start allowing more predictability in the gameplay. Updating these systems will also lead to less ground clutter, as you can predict what you are getting with any given action.

We've already adjusted fishing based on player feedback, as it used to be random, but now fishing spots will show you which type of fish are available. Next up, we've decided to split out the Herb N Spice from the Gonut bush and give it its own forage item/action.

In future updates we will work through mining resources (the # generated per node) and crab pots. We will also make forage items deterministic – one forage action produces one item. We’ll also improve how dynamic resources spawn (trees, fishing spots, etc) in zones. notes.title: Go-Go Town! Preview Branch is now available!
notes.content:
Hello Mayors! 

We are officially opening up our Preview Branch for testing, and wanted to let you all know in case you wanted to join in. Here's some FAQs for you, as well as instructions on how to get in: 

What is the Preview Branch?
The Preview Branch is a place for us to test out larger or more complicated changes early in order to get feedback before we push it live to the rest of the players.

Using the Preview Branch does get you access to the latest and greatest patches, however it does come with an increased risk of game breaking bugs or instability.

Rest assured we automatically back up your saves, so should you wish to return to the Main branch you are able to do so!

Once we are happy with the changes in the Preview Branch, we will bring them back to Main for all our players to enjoy. 

How to switch to the Preview Branch?

 Right click on the game in your steam library and select Properties, then
 Select ‘Betas’ from the menu
 Under ‘Beta Participation’ select ‘preview’.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/a4f3ce8fcfc59010d055790955df69b15f98be1c.png

What happens to my saved games?
You can load your saves as normal in the preview branch. However, whenever you save over an old save that was created from the main/default branch the game will archive this file so you can recover it later if there was an issue on preview.

These archives of main branch saves are stored in [code]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Prideful Sloth\Go-Go Town!\SaveArchive[/code] Each save will be in its own sub directory so you can open this folder and copy saves back to the main save directory if you would like to load them in the main branch. 

How do I submit feedback or bug reports?
To submit feedback or bug reports while in the preview branch, please use the F8 Feedback form as normal. Feel free to add your Steam username or Discord (if you're in the Prideful Sloth Discord) handle to the description on the report so we can contact you if we need extra information. We also have a dedicated set of channels on our Discord server specifically reserved for Preview Branch conversation that you're welcome to join.

Can I switch back?
Of course! Keep in mind, that any saves that were made while in the Beta Branch will likely not work when returning to the main branch.  So you may need to transfer previous saves back out of your Save Archive to continue from where you left off. 

How do I know which Branch I am in ?
If you have the game running, you can look to the version number watermark:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/965e0b7a989977ae8cd66f7ddac645db8cba8f91.png
If you are in the Preview Branch, the version number will be red, and have a ‘PREVIEW’ suffix.  Main will be white, with an ‘EA’ suffix.

From the Steam Library, the game name will be displayed as  if you are in the preview branch : 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/9b9ec1aea8709e1b88800c3c1d990025537af320.png

Happy experimenting and bug squashing - it really is invaluable to us! 

Cheers,
the Go-Go Town team

notes.content:
Hi all!

Another week in, and another update from me 😊
As promised last week, I’d have some updates for you this week on the following:

 Further details on the Preview branch
 Details on what Minor Update 3 will contain
 An ETA on when Suggestion Pack is expected to hit Preview Branch (and then main game)
 Updates to our Living Roadmap

Preview Branch + AI Updates
ETA: Discord users 16th – 17th 
ETA: Steam users ~22nd – 25th 

The updates to the AI system are just about done and we are starting to do some internal testing. Based off our testing, this is *really* helping solve the issues that have been reported.

However, we expect there’s still going to be some user experience issues around this (people standing still) without understanding why. The preview branch is going to be fantastic to help us work through these!

We are also putting the finishing touches on the Preview branch. While spinning up a branch isn’t too hard, the reason we are working through this is for a few reasons

 We want to keep your save intact; should you swap from the ‘game’ branch to the ‘preview branch’ we want to make sure your saves get backed up so you don’t lose your progress or end up with saves being ‘locked’ to this branch so you can’t go back to the normal game branch
 Save file updates; this means we need to increment your save file data in a way that makes sure if you use the preview branch and then go back to the game branch your saves won’t load in the game branch. As preview branch has its own data, it could create a lot of weird and wonderful issues if you could load it in the main game!
 Reporting tool; we need to make sure that we are getting details of which branch you are on should you report bugs to us, so we need to get this updated to work with multiple branches.

We’ll be rolling out this branch as an invite only to Discord users next week to confirm that the branching, save backup, and reporting tools are working as expected.

Once we are happy that this is working as expected, we’ll open this up to Steam users and include a post for how to access the Preview Branch on the Discussion Forum.

(see note below)

notes.title: Go-Go Town! Developer Update – 5th July
notes.content:
Hi all!

Another week down and another lengthy post from me 😊
There has been a lot going on at Sloth HQ, and I’m just going to dive right into it.

Minor Update 2 
ETA: 8th July

This update is a tad smaller, as we are working on a number of bigger changes we want to get out to sooner that we originally planned (see AI, and Preview Branch topics below)
However, we do still have some updates for you this week that we think will make you happy 😊 Aliens will start arriving on the train; if you have already called them, they are coming back!
 We’ve updated some AI pathfinding which should decrease some amount of AI ‘litter’ you are seeing around town
 Minor Bug fixes
 Minor Stability fixes

Major Update 1 – Player Suggestion Pack is the Winner!
ETA: Details next week

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/94123256f25cefe40976aed9808dd8ca83435839.jpg

After reviewing all the awesome feedback we received from our community, we decided that we wanted to give our community the opportunity to feedback into what our first major update would look like.

Thank you to all of you who voted, but also to those of you who have raised your feedback to us. This really helped inform where you wanted us to focus first.

The Suggestion Pack was voted on by the community, so this is where we’ll focus our attention first.
This pack will include the following updates: Expanded Player and Town cosmetics
 Open up a new area of the town map
 Add in a new tourist ‘teleporter’ that ensures tourists can reach your new building area
 Extend some zones to give a bit more space
 **Stretch Goal: Zone customisationWe are excited about this pack and think it’ll bring a lot to players!

The team will need a few more days to investigate the details of the workload in this pack and we’ll have an ETA on it next week.


Ongoing AI Updates

In releasing Update 0.4.47.15713EA it uncovered a few bugs with how AI works, as well as some User Experience issues around AI and how it behaves. 

I talked a bit last week about how AI is a spider web of systems here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2195120/view/4200250669025535502?l=english

AI is going to be an ongoing bit of work. We will continue to work on solving issues as an ongoing basis. And we’ll likely be featuring updates on a weekly basis about what we are doing, and what issues have been uncovered.

Some of the issues raised from the last update are:
 AI will pick-up and put down an item repeatedly (sometimes looks like it is juggling)
 This issue is related to it knowing it has something to do, but not being able to reach its destination. We have decided to rework the logic around AI’s pathfinding and decision-making to help with this issue.
 AI continues to process items even when no storage is available
 Under investigation!
 AI not tidying up, or picking up stuff on the ground
 This is an issue around how the AI is processing priorities, so we need to adjust the priority of this AI harvesting new materials when items are on the ground
 This is another priority-based issue; we need to adjust the priority of this
 AI in Fishing Zone leaving piles of fish around
 We are looking to move Fishing over to fixed fish-type catch spots. This means AI, and you, know exactly what you are getting when you drop a line in 😊 As this changes how fishing works, community feedback on this is going to be useful.
Speaking of community feedback… we are looking to bring forward our plans to adopt a ‘second’ branch. Which leads on to our next topic nicely!


A ‘Preview’ branch 

Those of you who play a lot of Early Access games you may already be used to the concept of a second, opt-in, branch. Its name can vary, but you might be familiar with Beta, Unstable, Untested, Feature, Preview... 

For us, moving forward, what we want to do is push our updates in this Preview (opt-in) branch and give it some time to percolate with our players before we adopt it into the ‘main game’ branch.

This is great, because it means we will be able to have some early dialogue between us (as developers and community) about what the impact of changes are, before we adopt them into the full game.
I’ll have more details on this next week – however, we are hoping we will have this adopted by Minor Update 3.


Wheels in Motion Pack

There is a bit of a silver lining here :D I know some of you were really excited about what this pack would bring to the table, and we promise it’s not getting scrapped.

What we are going to do with this pack look to split it out into smaller pieces and deliver these items over time.

The other nice thing about this pack is that it’s not all dependant on our Code team, so Art and Design have time to work together on this.

So, you’ll likely see  our future Minor Updates containing bits from this.


What is a Minor and Major Update?

Just in case you are curious what these names mean. Here’s something I prepared just for you:

Minor updates are generally going to include following:
 Include ongoing bug fixes
 Include ongoing quality of life updates
 Include small content updates
Major updates are generally going to include the following:
 New major features! Yay
 Large content updates
 Gameplay updates

Living Roadmap Updates
We are now at the first juncture where we want to update our Living Roadmap! The winning pack for Major Update 1 will be reflected in this, and I’ll looking at updating with other details where I can.
I am sure there is more I could write, but honestly, I suspect you are just as excited as we are to start diving into the updates – both Minor and Major 😊


Next weeks update from me should be an exciting one:
 Further details on the Preview branch 
 Details on what Minor Update 3 will contain
 An ETA on when Suggestion Pack is expected to hit Preview Branch (and then main game)
 Updates to our Living Roadmap
Let me just close this out by saying ‘Thank you’ to everyone who is joining us on this journey! We are a small, but mighty, team and we are working hard to make sure your voice is heard, and you continue to enjoy Go-Go Town! through each and every update.

- Cheryl

notes.title: Go-Go Town! Developer Update - 25th June
notes.content:
Hi all! 

We are a few hours shy of our 1st week out from Early Access release, and wow has it been a week 😊
Diving right into player bugs and feedback here’s some of the most raised items

Map Size
Worker AI
Space in Zones (Mining, Forestry, Fishing, Farming)
Did I mention Map Size
Accessibility options for Motion and Visual Sensitivities, as well as phobias

What I suspect you really want to know is WHEN these bits of feedback are going to be addressed. So that’s what I’ll cover first, and then we can dive into the topics in a bit more detail.

Minor Update 1

ETA: 1st July (Australia time)
What to expect:
Bug fixes for Courier AI
We will provide more details next week on these We are aware of a few issues, so we’re aiming to address as many as possible Fishing Rod Fix
Some of you may have a fishing rod attached to you for life 😊 We will be detaching this from you.Floating Birds
These birds somehow seem to be able to defy physics and float when they walk. Don’t worry! The birds will still fly correctly.Farm AI not using Feed 
TownCo. has assured us that workers are undergoing training to understand the correct procedures for handling of fodder and feeding of animals.Worker AI – Locked Storage Edition
As a low priority task, Worker AI will work to ensure locked storage boxes are full. Even when those items are not considered ‘in demand’ in town.  Too Much Stuff – The Overflow Chronicles
You will find a new machine available to you (Tech Tree tier pending)This machine is only usable by Players (for now, see the AI topic below) You can dispose of items in this machine, and in return for X number of items you will receive some Import TicketsAdditional Bug Fixes that we'll flag next week.

Zone/Industry AI feedback

Just to touch on this as a more holistic topic and note that we understand this first update is only touching on some parts of AI feedback.

Worker AI is a bit of a spiderweb, where touching one part can have far-reaching effects. With this in mind, we are trying to chunk up the feedback into manageable topics and starting with a light touch to address a few of the more immediate issues.

We want to avoid trying to provide a slew of solutions in one go! For one, as a team of five people trying to test all the use-cases before we release a big update to AI would take longer than we want to ask you to wait :D We also do not want to end up in a position where we have over engineered AI and end up causing another set of problems. Last thing we need to do is create a waterfall of new issues.

We have broken down the AI worker feedback into is the following issues:
AI over-producing resources
Think piles of fish on the ground Without poking at core balance of numbers, what we want to do in the short term, is allow players a way to destroy unwanted goods (not just sell them at the Market Stall and Vending Machines) Workers backpacks filling up
This is an issue unto itself, but it does also come down to the workers not having the space to get rid of their items, as well as over producing of items Storage Bins being placed outside of zonesThis is not clearly signed to players about WHO can access bins based on where they are placed. We need to work on visually communicating this, as there are reasons for a player wanting to place bins outside of their industry zones.However, bins are being placed outside of zones and is creating the illusion of AI being broken, when in fact it’s just that the bin is not accessible by some workers. How AI deals with locked storage (and player expectation of this)
We are aiming to have AI have a lower-level priority of ensuring bins are full, so it doesn’t feel like there’s an overbalance of item A and an under balance of item B. Communicating issues/breakdowns in Worker AILonger term we need to start using notifications as a way to alert the player there are problems happening in their Zones/Industries. We are going to hold off on this for now, as we need to clear some of the ‘backlog’ of other issues.We don’t want to spam you too much here :D However, we might start rolling out some notifications sooner rather than later. Not being able to access storage is a good example of one we can do that shouldn’t create too much ‘notification spam’  
Map Size and Zone Expansion

We have heard your requests, and we want to start doing what we can here!

Of all the industry zones, Farm has been your #1 request to expand.

Generally, you are asking for bigger maps!

We had map expansions planned for a future update; however, we acknowledge that this is something we need to prioritise NOW 😊 So, we are! But we also ask that you are patient with us on this – and I aim to have more news next week on this front.

Map expansion has a couple of major knock-on effects that we need to address before we roll this out. 

Performance! 
We have been working hard to keep the game running to a decently low spec, which also means having it run smoothly on Steam Deck. So, we need to do some performance testing before we just dump a whole new area of the map on you. Moving tourists around the town
Right now tourists have a limited set of time they will spend in town, and also a wander distance on them. There’s a WHOLE set of stuff we wanted to do to revamp their AI, but if we move forward with expanding the map sooner, we need to have some quicker solutions in place. We are investigating Tourist path-finding and what it would take to add subways and/or some form of ‘teleportation’ of tourists around the map. If you can build there, we need to make sure that tourists can get there! What we do not want to do is lock away some zones to say ‘this is only for residential’. If you can build there, you can put what you want there, and it should be utilised by the AI. 
Minor Updates and Bug Fixes
We are working on an ongoing release process, and Minor Update 1 will form the first of this.

We want to get weekly updates out to you.
These updates will include minor bug fixes as well as gameplay improvements, and where possible bits of new content 😊
We’ll be aiming to release updates on Mondays (Australia time), pending testing and QA times.

If/When Major bugs creep in we will continue to fix this in a timely manner with Hot Fixes!

Major Updates

Our first Major Update is “Wheels in Motion”, is set for release at the end of July. As we get closer to release, we’ll do a unique post about what to expect from this update!

Communication

For the next month or two, as we work through feedback, we’ll be working to do weekly updates with our community.  We have a LOT of platforms to reach players on, so we’ll be trying our best to figure out how we do so: Mailing list, Steam, Twitter, Discord, TikTok, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, B站: / Bilibili, 小红书 / Little Red Book, 微博 / Weibo

In time, we’ll swap over to updates every two weeks. We’ll be checking in, letting you know what is up, and starting to show off new stuff 😊

For our Newsletter subscribers we aim to email out once a month, and when we do, we’ll have some unique content for you in there! Our first newsletter is planned for early July.

We Won an Award!

We attended the Queensland Games Festival on Saturday 22nd June, which is always a highlight for us to show off what we make in our hometown. And we walked away with the 'Best In Show' award!

Here's John (aka Wheels) accepting the award on behalf of the team!

notes.title: Go-Go Town! coming to Next Fest!
notes.content:
We’re going to be in Next Fest! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/1227ebd4dea34c2f78fa58223b1284351260ebac.jpg

Starting on June 10th (or maybe a bit before 😉), you’ll be able to dive in to a brand-new updated demo. Boss has thrown you right in the midst of a failing town, and you’ll have even more tools and décor at your disposal to bring it to glory. 

You’ll be able to experience: 

 The core gameplay loop of Go-Go Town!  🌇 build up your town, customize the layout, convince tourists to live in your town (then put them to work!), and automate your way to success! 
 Single Player and Co-op Play with up to 4 players 🎮⌨️ either local or via Steam Remote Play
 The ability to lay out your town the way you want 📐 put roads, rivers, and shops wherever you’d like
 16 shop varieties in three different sizes, machines to refine resources to build them, and recipes for food and items to sell at the shops
 Four industry zones: 🌾🎣🌳⛏️ Farming, Fishing, Forestry and Mining - all with power tools to help you gather resources
 Ride vehicles (with friends!) 🚙 and use them to carry materials around to help build your town
 Localised in-game text & subtitles 🔡 in French, German, Japanese, Simplified & Traditional Chinese, Korean, Thai, Brazilian Portuguese, and Latin America Spanish.

If you’ve played the demo before, we’ve also added a few new things - and the💡emoji means the update was inspired by our community!

 Updated AI 🤖 NPCs were pretty clueless at their job, we’ve made them less clueless. Workers will prioritize the needs of the town, couriers will carry multiple items, and more! (but still: be patient with them)
 Updated build mode 🏗️ We've made things easier to build in your town - edit and delete are now the same control, you can see the outline of a building before placing it, and now when you place décor items, you can rotate them before they get placed. 
 Camera controls 🎥 Zoom in and out, get some angled views - you're ready for your close up! 
 Expanded Industry 🧰 Introducing: protein! You can harvest it from mushrooms on the farm, or use the seafood converter in the Fishing Zone, and different shops will use it in new recipes. We've also added new recipes for processors, so you can make cheese, honey and butter, as well as additional seeds for the farm.
 New tourists 💁🏻‍♀️  If you want to have tourists join your town, they'll now have special requests: build something, collect something, or sometimes just pay them - it depends! 
 Updated map 🗺️ The map is now super-charged. There are more elements that you can see, like individual tourists, you can filter it to only show what you're interested in - or what you'd like to hide away
 Quality of Life Upgrades 📈 
 Save management has been added, and your save file will show details about your town when you load it.
 💡 We've changed language in areas to be more clear - machines will now say "set recipe" so it's super clear.
 💡Customize the colors of buildings and shops. This isn't fully customizable yet, but there are now color randomizers attached to most buildings.
 💡Un-hire couriers (we know this has been a big ask!)
 You can now hold to pick up and drop items (very useful with throwing garbage out)
 Swinging on swings is now possible
 💡 Re-binding keys (also very requested!)
 Controllers will now rumble

And that’s not all! We’re excited to announce that we’ll be included in the PC Gaming Show this Sunday, June 9th at 1pm PT (June 10th @ 6am AUS time) and we HIGHLY recommend you tune in—we’ve got some pretty great things to share! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/ee7c9b1264e2f4d201425122a5ba54cc489590cd.jpg

You can check it out on Twitch or YouTube - don’t forget to put it on your calendar!

notes.title: Join us in March for Playtest 4
notes.content:
Gosh!

How is it March already?! It feels like it was only a few weeks ago that we wrapped up Playtest 3. Yet here we are! Playtest 4 is starting. 

The team has been busy working on getting new features in, as well as getting everything ready so you can recruit additional Mayors to help with your town.

Local/Splitscreen Co-op has been a lot of fun for the team do develop. We've also identified the 'chaotic' team members amongst us. I won't name anyone, but you KNOW who you are :D

I realised late Feb that I had not posted a mini roadmap for this playtest. I am truly sorry about that! It slipped past me.

Playtest 4 has been such a great reflection point for the team! 

At this time last year (early March 2023) we were frantically getting a build in order, preparing to announce the game and showcase it at PAX East. We were very nervous about how Go-Go Town! would be received. It was VERY early in development (it had only been in development for a year), and we were really worried about showing it so early.

And here we are, one year on from that. We are no longer worried about showing the game so early. The playtests, and feedback from players, have been amazing. They have helped us work out what to focus on, and understand what is important to you. The feedback has helped guide the big and small in the game. From a complete redo of the opening of the game (and tutorials) to the types of fun and playful content we have in the game :)

We are also excited that we have so much happening this month - it feels like a celebration of how far we've progressed in the past year!

We are part of the Women-led Games Showcase (https://www.twitch.tv/womenledgames), as well as The Games with Wings Showcase (https://www.twitch.tv/wingsfundme). Both of these are absolute honours to be a part of. There are so many amazing games out there, and to think that we'd be considered worthy of showing is heartwarming.

We're also sending some of the team to GDC in a few weeks, so hopefully you aren't getting too fatigued about hearing from the team.

From a development point of view, we have been working through our backlog and starting to prioritise what we want to get into the game next. We'll be supporting the playtest and fixing bugs that you might come across! However, we do want to start thinking about 'What Next'. And I'll work to get a roadmap up for this sometime in April.

I'll wrap up here - and I'll include the details for Playtest 4 invites below. 

I do, however, want to just say one more time 'Thank you for joining us over the past year'.

<3 Cheryl & The Prideful Sloth Team

What changes have been made since the last Playtest? 👷🏻


 Split-Screen Co-op 👥 That's right, play with up to four total people in split-screen co-op, either Local or via Steam Remote Play
 New Hidden Areas 🔍 What, did you think we would just tell you where they are? Go explore!
 New Clothing, Props, and Décor 👔🎇🍄 We've got two new sets of props and decorations, the Lunar New Year Set and the Fairy Set!
 New Vehicles 🚲 🪲 With co-op comes new ways to ride vehicles with friends—try them out! We also have TWO new vehicles, a quad bike and a secret one that you'll have to find (but we promise it's worth it)
 Fishing Updates 🎣 Everyone wants that thrill of pulling up a boot instead of a fish, so we've delivered. Junk fishing spots are now available!
 Emotes & Rock Paper Scissors 👊🏽 ✋🏼✌🏾You can high-five and play Rock Paper Scissors with your co-op buddies (farm animals will also join in on some high-fives!)
 Performance, Physics, and UI Improvements 🎛️ We've put in fixes for usability in the Build and Manage menus
 New languages 🔡 Added Thai, Korean, and Traditional Chinese Languages

🗓️ It will be open from now through the end of the month (12:01AM U.S. PDT / 5PM AEST). We are inviting people in waves to make sure things don't get overwhelmed, so you might get access before your friends! Everyone on our mailing list will be invited by March 19, and then we'll start sending out keys automatically.

notes.title: Go-Go Town! Roadmap for Oct/Nov 2023
notes.content:
Hi all!

Gosh, how is it October already?!

We've had a busy few months, and we'll continue to busy into November.

Previous Events
We had Gamescom in August, and boy was that busy for everyone involved. We were part of the Australia Booth in the Business Area, as well as Indie Arena Booth in the consumer hall.

Two booths, and five days, we sure kept busy! But it was 1000% worth it. We got to meet so many amazing people during our time there. It was just such a positive event all around.

September saw us at Tokyo Game Show where we were part of the Select Indie 80 there. It was such an honour to be selected as part of the Indie 80 showcase. We were humbled by how many amazing games that were chosen. We truly had a fantastic time and want to go back.

Recent Events
Rounding out the year for us was PAX Australia. It's always a great time to exhibit locally. It's also nice that it's a 'short' flight compared to the other shows we've attended this year. :D

We had an amazing weekend meeting so many wonderful people, and it was such a joy to show off more of Couch Co-op. Keep a watch out on our social channels if you want to see how that's progressing <3

Awards
This is exciting for us, as this is our first award nomination. We were a finalist for the Best International Game at Level Up KL 2023. 

Due to timing, we were unable to attend :( But we were beyond humbled to have been short listed alongside a number of amazing titles!

Next Playtest
We do not have an exact date yet but will be holding our next playtest in November. It only feels like we just wrapped up our last playtest, and yet we're already planning our next one!

This will be our last playtest for the year - so we sure hope you join us.

Roadmap
I am sure this is what you are really here for... our next update to our roadmap.

One of the big focuses we are working towards for this playtest, will be the long-term gameplay loop. This has been in the works for a while now, and we're looking forward to your feedback on it! We'll continue to improve and expand on it for future playtests. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/0c329041a884c4c8b64b5d7879698829d795a68a.jpg

There's plenty of other things in there, too :) We hope you’re as excited as we are for this playtest.

-Prideful Sloth <3

notes.title: Go-Go Town! Roadmap June 2023
notes.content:
Greetings Mayors!

We know that Go-Go Town! is still some time away from releasing. However, we wanted to make sure we start communicating our Road Map for the game early on in development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43837161/5037230629d1aff44a603f71b5983ab7e6c378d9.jpg

What does all of this mean?
The TownCo is in the detail, so below is bit more info on each of these topics.

Current
⏱️  Start of Game Flow  
Our next playtests will really focus on the start of the game—how does it feel, do you get the information you need, how is the story being told. Since this touches on most things in the game, you might not see major changes, but it’ll be a series of small shifts to make it the best experience possible.

📑 Tutorialization
TownCo is brushing off their training manuals to get things ready for you so you can learn as you go!

🗺️ New starting map
We all loved DemoTown, but TownCo’s got a brand new spot where they’re going to drop you

🪜 Tech Tree
Wondering what all that EGO is for? You’ll have tech trees where you can spend points to unlock new shops, items, and more!

🏘️ House and Shop overhaul
We want to make sure that there's variety to the town, so we are working on the visuals for houses and shops to do just this!

💾 Save/Load 
Just so you don’t have to keep your computer running overnight 😉

🏗️ Move + Delete
Moving and deleting buildings and decoration will be available (rotating decoration items is on our long-term list—but not rotating buildings)

🐛 Addressing some feedback and squashing bugs from the first super-early pre-Alpha demo
 
Upcoming
🗺️ A Map
Don’t you want a way around town? We want that too!

🛟 Help System
TownCo representatives are standing by… 

🌾Updates on growth/completion for farm goods
We’re going to add ways for you to know if a crop will take a short or long time to grow, and how to know it’s ready

🌏 Localisation
The final list of languages is still to be determined, but we’re going to start this process early so more folks can join in. 

🤖 Updates to AI logic
Mandated our couriers re-read the training manual to ensure they are performing at optimal (or semi-optimal, the TownCo way) expectations

📈 Long-term game ‘goals’
TownCo has some lofty goals they want you to achieve!
 
Backlog
🕰️ Skip time 
Tired of nightime? Hate noon? Say goodbye to it!

🚙 NPC driving (not just couriers)
You’ll have some competition on the roads—NPCs will be able to drive

🕺🏽More depth to NPCs
No, this doesn’t mean romance! We’ll have more details on this when the time comes, but there’s more to come for our beloved townfolk. 

💇🏻‍♂️Player Character customization
You’ll have lots of options for hair cut, color, and clothing to make your Mayor the most (or least!) stylish out there. Hair and clothing options will not be gender-locked, either.

🚧 Long-term town maintenance
Keep things up to TownCo standards! Otherwise they’ll [REDACTED]

🔄 Rotate some objects (but not shops or houses!)
Pick the corner that’s most ideal for a trashcan. You know you want to.
